title: Land at KIX, first night in Osaka

stops.name: Kansai Airport (KIX)
stops.notes: Immigration + bags ~45-60 min. Buy 4× ICOCA (¥2,000 incl ¥500 deposit) and load ~¥10,000 each.

stops.name: BON Condominium Umeda
stops.legNote: Airport Limousine Bus to Umeda, ~60-70 min, pay at counter

stops.name: Dinner: Kinryu Ramen Midosuji
stops.mapsQuery: Kinryu Ramen Midosuji Dotonbori Osaka, Japan
stops.notes: Or Ichiran. Skip Dotonbori if too tired, eat near hotel.

quickStops.name: Rikuro's Cheesecake (Namba flagship)
quickStops.mapsQuery: Rikuro Ojisan Namba Honten Osaka, Japan
quickStops.notes: Buy a whole one for the hotel

stops.name: Minoh Station
stops.legNote: Hankyu Takarazuka Line, change at Ishibashi Handai-mae, ~30 min

stops.name: Walk down to Minoh Station
stops.notes: 2.7 km gentle downhill. Lunch at Yuzuriha on the way, momiji tempura snack. Derailleur Brew Works at the station (optional).

stops.name: Osaka Castle (Otemon Gate)
stops.notes: Exterior + moat walk, free. Drops first if the day runs long.
stops.legNote: Hankyu back to Umeda, then Tanimachi Line to Tanimachi 4-chome

stops.name: Dinner: Yaekatsu (kushikatsu)
stops.notes: Backups Tengu, Omiya, Daruma. Home via Shin-Imamiya → Loop Line to Osaka.

quickStops.name: Onigiri Gorichan
quickStops.whatToEat: Rice balls — quick breakfast near the hotel

quickStops.name: Derailleur Brew Works
quickStops.whatToEat: Craft beer / soft drinks by Minoh Station

quickStops.name: Takoyaki Wanaka (Osaka Castle Park)
quickStops.mapsQuery: Takoyaki Wanaka Osaka Castle Park, Japan

stops.name: Osaka-Namba (Kintetsu)
stops.notes: Train 6703, Car 2, Seats 8A-8D. Show the live e-ticket on the Kintetsu site (no screenshots). Base fare: tap ICOCA.

stops.name: Ise Jingu Naiku (Inner Shrine)
stops.mapsQuery: Ise Jingu Naiku Uji Bridge, Japan
stops.legNote: Shrine bus / CAN Bus ~15-20 min, ICOCA

stops.name: Lunch: Fukusuke + Okage Yokocho
stops.notes: Ise udon, ★3.60. Browse Okage Yokocho after.

stops.name: Dotonbori + Hozenji Yokocho
stops.notes: Dinner open, decide on the spot. Tonight: stroller to Yamato for 22 Nov delivery to Kyoto.

quickStops.name: Tofu Sorano
quickStops.mapsQuery: Tofu Sorano Minami Senba Osaka, Japan

quickStops.name: Rikuro's Cheesecake (Namba)
quickStops.mapsQuery: Rikuro Ojisan Namba Honten Osaka, Japan

title: Arashiyama, then check in to Kyoto

stops.name: Saga-Arashiyama Station
stops.legNote: JR Kyoto Line → Kyoto, JR Sagano Line, ~55 min

stops.name: Lunch: Arashiyama Daizen
stops.notes: ★3.61 regional sushi, near Randen Saga. Call 075-882-0018.

stops.name: Rinn Kamiebisu (drop bags)
stops.notes: Hotel holds bags; check-in 16:00. Stroller arrives via Yamato.

quickStops.name: Arashiyama Yoshimura
quickStops.whatToEat: Soba with river view — Tabelog 3.51, can queue

shopStops.name: Tenryu-ji Daruma screen
shopStops.whatToFind: Large Daruma screen painting in the entrance hall
shopStops.notes: Already on the route — just look for it

stops.name: Kintetsu Kyoto Station
stops.notes: Train 807, Car 2, Seats 8A-8D. Live e-ticket + ICOCA for base fare.

stops.name: Nakatanidou (mochi pounding)
stops.notes: ¥130-250 per piece. Pounding shows are irregular.

stops.name: Lunch: Mizuya Chaya
stops.notes: Udon + matcha on the road to Kasuga Taisha.

stops.name: Dinner: Kyoto Sumibi Kushiyaki Tsujiy
backupOptions: Toridashi Oden Tsujiya — Kyoto Stn West, ★3.17

shopStops.name: Naramachi craft shops
shopStops.whatToFind: Akahada-yaki pottery, Nara sumi ink, hand-printed cloth

stops.name: Fushimi Inari Taisha
stops.notes: Free, open 24 h. Go at first light.

stops.name: Kiyomizu-dera
stops.legNote: Keihan Line Fushimi-Inari → Kiyomizu-Gojo, then walk uphill

stops.name: Mochi Mochi + Ninenzaka / Sannenzaka
stops.notes: Mochi pounding ¥1,000. Yasaka Pagoda on the way.

stops.name: Dinner: Kyoto Gion Okaru
stops.notes: Curry udon ★3.59, cash. Backup Musou Shin Gion.

stops.name: Kyoto Station: collect Klook tickets
stops.notes: Scan Klook QR at a JR machine for the Nagoya → Matsumoto and Matsumoto → Kiso tickets. Stroller to Yamato at the hotel (→ Kanazawa, 29 Nov).

quickStops.name: Fujinami (Kodaiji branch)
quickStops.whatToEat: Mitarashi dango, warabi mochi, matcha set — Tabelog 3.45

quickStops.name: MACCHA HOUSE
quickStops.mapsQuery: Maccha House Kyoto Shijo Kawaramachi, Japan

shopStops.name: Kiyomizu-zaka / Gojozaka pottery shops
shopStops.whatToFind: Kiyomizu-yaki teacups, small plates, incense holders

shopStops.name: Teramachi-dori (north of Oike)
shopStops.mapsQuery: Teramachi Dori Oike Kyoto Ippodo, Japan
shopStops.whatToFind: Antique and print shops, calligraphy, shikishi boards; Ippodo tea main shop

shopStops.name: Shinmonzen-dori
shopStops.whatToFind: Japan's top antique street: byobu, scrolls, lacquer, ceramics
shopStops.notes: Go straight after Nishiki lunch (~13:30) — most shops close 5–6pm

shopStops.name: Furumonzen-dori
shopStops.whatToFind: More antique dealers, same walk as Shinmonzen

shopStops.name: Kennin-ji
shopStops.whatToFind: Wind God and Thunder God byobu (replica of the National Treasure), painted sliding doors, twin-dragon ceiling

stops.name: Matsumoto Station
stops.notes: Shinano 20 (check exact time on the Klook ticket).

stops.name: Kiso-Fukushima Station
stops.notes: Dinner at Dining KAWAI by the station, then check in by 18:30.

stops.name: Kiso Mikawaya
stops.notes: Hard check-in deadline. Dinner not included.

shopStops.name: Nakamachi Street craft shops
shopStops.whatToFind: Matsumoto folk crafts, wooden ware, everyday pottery

stops.name: Kiso-Fukushima Station
stops.notes: CASH only in the Kiso area (no ICOCA).

stops.name: Nakatsugawa Station
stops.notes: Bus stop 3, Kitaena bus to Magome.

stops.name: Magome Pass
stops.notes: The one real climb is done by here.

stops.name: Tsumago-juku + lunch at Otokichi
stops.notes: ~8 km total, 3-3.5 h. Sawadaya chestnut sweets after.

stops.name: Matsumoto Bus Terminal
stops.notes: Seats 1A-1D. PRINTED voucher only, driver keeps it.

stops.name: Sanmachi Suji old town
stops.notes: Merchant houses, sake breweries. Dinner: Ajihei near the station.

shopStops.name: Takayama old-town antique shops
shopStops.whatToFind: Old lacquerware, Shibukusa-yaki pottery, Ichii itto-bori carving

stops.name: Hida Furukawa + lunch
stops.notes: Seto River canal, Your Name spots. Ajidokoro Furukawa (before 14:00) or Soba Sho Nakaya.

shopStops.name: Mishima candle shop (Hida Furukawa)
shopStops.whatToFind: Hand-painted Japanese candles; watch them being made

shopStops.name: Takayama antique + Shibukusa-yaki shops
shopStops.whatToFind: Second unhurried pass for antiques and Shibukusa pottery

stops.name: Shiroyama Viewpoint
stops.notes: Best panoramic view. Shuttle bus up, walk down.

stops.name: Lunch: Irori
stops.notes: Reservation confirmed. Purin no Ie pudding after (optional).

stops.name: Shirakawa-go bus terminal
stops.notes: Be there by ~14:55. Seats 6A/6B/7A/7B. Printed e-ticket.

stops.name: Hotel Forza Kanazawa
stops.notes: Check in. Stroller arrives via Yamato.

stops.name: Higashi Chaya + Kazuemachi
stops.notes: Lantern-lit teahouse streets. Dinner: Fukuwauchi (~6pm, closes 19:30).

shopStops.name: Higashi Chaya craft shops
shopStops.whatToFind: Kutani-yaki porcelain, gold-leaf trays and boxes

stops.name: Kenrokuen (early, free entry)
stops.notes: Free before opening via Mayumizaka gate.

stops.name: Dinner: Izakaya Gappa
stops.notes: Station front. Tonight: collect Kagayaki tickets, stroller to Yamato (→ Tokyo, 3 Dec).

shopStops.name: Shintatemachi
shopStops.whatToFind: Design, craft and vintage shops; modern Kutani

shopStops.name: Katani shop (after the gold-leaf class)
shopStops.whatToFind: Gold-leaf dishes, boxes, small tabletop items

stops.name: Kanazawa Station
stops.notes: Kagayaki 502, Car 5, Seats 10D/10E/11D/11E. Breakfast: convenience store.

stops.name: Shinjuku Station (Platform 9)
stops.notes: Collect Fuji Excursion tickets (Klook QR) at a JR machine first. Car 4, Seats 3A/3B/4A/4B. Grab ekiben for lunch.

stops.name: Kawaguchiko Hotel
stops.notes: Check in, rest. No sightseeing today on purpose.

stops.name: Oishi Park
stops.notes: Clearest air early. Breakfast at Café DINA.

stops.name: Chureito Pagoda
stops.notes: ~400 steps up. Go early to beat groups.
stops.legNote: Bus/train via Kawaguchiko to Shimoyoshida, ~30 min

stops.name: Oshino Hakkai
stops.notes: Spring-fed ponds. Good if Fuji clouds over.

stops.name: Kachi Kachi Ropeway
stops.notes: Only if Fuji is visible and queues are short.

stops.name: Dinner: Koshu Houtou Kosaku
stops.notes: ★3.49. Backup Hoto Fudo. Onsen at the hotel.

title: Shinjuku, Harajuku, Shibuya
stay: APA Hotel Higashi Shinjuku Kabukicho Tower

stops.name: Kawaguchiko Station
stops.notes: Bus 1102, Seats 01C/01D/02C/02D. QR on phone. Last Fuji look before.

stops.name: APA Hotel Kabukicho Tower (drop bags)
stops.mapsQuery: APA Hotel Higashi Shinjuku Kabukicho Tower, Japan

stops.name: Omoide Yokocho / Golden Gai / Don Quijote
stops.notes: Pick by energy. Tokyo Metropolitan Govt Building view is free.

shopStops.name: Oriental Bazaar

shopStops.notes: Most realistic place to buy a byobu — check December hours

stops.name: Lunch: Mendokoro Honta, Akihabara

stops.name: Hara Shobo, Jimbocho

stops.name: Ginza

stops.name: Dinner, then pack

quickStops.name: Heckeln

shopStops.notes: Inside Ueno Park; 60–90 min; display rotates every few weeks

shopStops.name: Kappabashi ceramic shops
shopStops.whatToFind: Best-value ceramics in Japan: rice bowls, sake sets, plates; seconds bins outside shops

shopStops.name: Hara Shobo
shopStops.whatToFind: Ukiyo-e woodblock prints — originals and restrikes

shopStops.name: S. Watanabe Color Print Co.
shopStops.mapsQuery: S. Watanabe Color Print Ginza, Japan
shopStops.whatToFind: New hand-made woodblock prints (Hokusai, Hiroshige designs)

shopStops.name: Antique Mall Ginza
shopStops.whatToFind: Many antique dealers under one roof; screens, scrolls, ceramics

stops.name: APA Hotel Kabukicho Tower
stops.mapsQuery: APA Hotel Higashi Shinjuku Kabukicho Tower, Japan
